name: PD 151 was established by Ordinance No. 17831, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 18, 1983. Ordinance No. 17831 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17831; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 151 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 151 was established by Ordinance No. 17831, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 18, 1983. Ordinance No. 17831 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 151 is established on property generally located east of and parallel to the east line of Meandering Way, north of the north line of Mullrany Drive. The size of PD 151 is approximately 2.8316 acres. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-151.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with the lot arrangement and street location as shown on the city plan commission-approved development plan, which is labelled Exhibit 151A. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.105.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat as approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk. In conjunction with the submission of the subdivision plat, a legal instrument establishing a plan for the permanent care and maintenance of any common area or communally-owned facility must be submitted to and approved by the city attorney as to legal form and by the city plan commission as to suitability for the proposed use of the common area. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.106.USES. Development within this PD is limited to detached dwellings for single-family uses only to be developed to Townhouse-2 District standards, except as otherwise noted below. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.107.DENSITY. Development is limited to 17 detached dwelling units for single-family uses only. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.108.MAXIMUM HEIGHT. Maximum allowable height for any building or structure in this PD is 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-151.109.PAVING.
(a)All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must be constructed to the requirements of Division 51-4.300, “Off-street Parking and Loading Regulations,” and Section 51-4.604, “Access Standards.”
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.110.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51-7.400. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.111.MAINTENANCE. All common areas and walls must be maintained in a state of good repair, and all landscaped areas must be maintained in a healthy growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.112.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development of this property must be in compliance with all codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.113.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-151.114.ZONING MAP. PD 151 is located on Zoning Map No. A-8. (Ord. Nos. 17831; 25508)
